muyesser-irab:1-1.t:
﴿يسألونك عن الأنفال قل الأنفال لله والرسول﴾: resumptive speech with no grammatical position; يسألونك is an imperfect verb, its fāʿil (agent) and its mafʿūl bihi (direct object); عن الأنفال is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) يسألونك; قل is an imperative verb; الأنفال is the mubtadaʾ (subject) and لله is its khabar (predicate), and the nominal clause is in the position of an accusative as the object of saying (maqūl al-qawl); and الرسول is conjoined to الله.
﴿فاتقوا الله وأصلحوا ذات بينكم وأطيعوا الله ورسوله إن كنتم مؤمنين﴾: the ف is the faṣīḥa fāʾ; اتقوا is an imperative verb and its fāʿil, and the Name of Majesty is the mafʿūl bihi; أصلحوا is conjoined to اتقوا; ذات بينكم is the mafʿūl bihi; إن is conditional; كنتم is the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ), the ت is its noun and مؤمنين is its khabar; and the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) is omitted because what precedes indicates it.

muyesser-irab:2-2.t:
﴿إنما المؤمنون الذين إذا ذكر الله وجلت قلوبهم﴾: إنما is the restraining (kāffa) and restrained (makfūfa) particle; المؤمنون is the mubtadaʾ (subject), and the clause is resumptive, with no grammatical position; الذين is the khabar (predicate); إذا is an adverb for what is future, containing the meaning of condition; the clause ذكر الله is in the position of a genitive as muḍāf ilayhi, and الله is the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent); and the clause وجلت قلوبهم has no grammatical position, because it is the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) of a non-jussive condition.
﴿وإذا تليت عليهم آياته زادتهم إيمانا﴾: conjunction [to] the first attribute; the clause زادتهم has no grammatical position; and إيمانًا is the second mafʿūl bihi (direct object), or a tamyīz (specification).
﴿وعلى ربهم يتوكلون﴾: a third attribute falling within the scope of the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative; على ربهم is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) يتوكلون.

muyesser-irab:3-3.t:
﴿الذين يقيمون الصلاة﴾: الذين is a badal (substitute); يقيمون الصلاة: a verb, its fāʿil (agent) and its mafʿūl bihi (direct object), and the clause has no grammatical position, being the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative.
﴿ومما رزقناهم ينفقون﴾: the و is a conjunction; مما: a preposition and its genitive noun; رزقناهم is a verb, its fāʿil and its mafʿūl bihi; and ينفقون is a verb and its fāʿil.

muyesser-irab:4-4.t:
﴿أولئك هم المؤمنون حقا﴾: the demonstrative is the mubtadaʾ (subject); هم is a pronoun of separation (ḍamīr faṣl), or a second khabar (predicate) [Translator's note: so in the source; on the second view هم would more usually be a second mubtadaʾ]; المؤمنون is the khabar in either case; the clause is the khabar of the demonstrative; and the clause is resumptive, with no grammatical position. ﴿حقًّا﴾ is a naʿt (adjective) of an omitted maṣdar (verbal noun), i.e.: they are the believers with a true belief (إيمانًا حقا); or a mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object) of an omitted verb, emphasising the content of the clause, the implied form being: حق ذلك حقا.
﴿لهم درجات عند ربهم ومغفرة ورزق كريم﴾: لهم is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted fronted khabar; درجات is the postponed mubtadaʾ; عند ربهم is an adverb attached to درجات, because it is in the sense of "rewards" (أجور), or attached to an omitted naʿt of درجات, because it is indefinite; and مغفرة ورزق كريم are conjoined to درجات.

muyesser-irab:5-5.t:
﴿كما أخرجك ربك من بيتك بالحق﴾: ﴿كما﴾: the ك is a noun in the sense of مثل (like), indeclinable (mabnī) on the fatḥa, in the position of a nominative as the khabar (predicate) of an omitted mubtadaʾ (subject), i.e.: this state — namely, their being removed from the assignment of the spoils (al-anfāl) — in their dislike of it, is like the state of your being brought out to war in their dislike of it; or their state in disliking what you saw fit of granting extra spoils to the fighters is like their state in disliking your going out to war. Or the ك is in the position of an accusative as a naʿt (adjective) of an omitted maṣdar (verbal noun), i.e.: the spoils are established for Allah and for the Messenger ﷺ with an establishment like the establishment of your Lord's bringing you out of your house. ﴿ما﴾ is a maṣdar particle; ﴿أخرجك﴾ is a past verb, and the ك of address is a pronoun in the position of an accusative as mafʿūl bihi (direct object); ﴿ربك﴾ is the fāʿil (agent); the clause ﴿أخرجك ربك﴾ is the ṣila of the maṣdar ﴿ما﴾, with no grammatical position; and the interpreted maṣdar from the maṣdar ﴿ما﴾ and the verb ﴿أخرج﴾ is muḍāf ilayhi, i.e.: كإخراج ربك إياك (like your Lord's bringing you out). ﴿من بيتك﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) أخرج; and ﴿بالحق﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial), i.e.: clothed with the truth (متلبسًا بالحق).
﴿وإن فريقا من المؤمنين لكارهون﴾: the و is circumstantial (ḥāliyya); إن is an abrogating particle (inna and its sisters); فريقًا is its noun; من المؤمنين is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted naʿt; the ل is the shifted lām (al-lām al-muzaḥlaqa); كارهون is the khabar of إن; and the clause is in the position of an accusative as a ḥāl of the ك in أخرجك, i.e.: He brought you out in a state of their disliking it.

muyesser-irab:6-6.t:
﴿يجادلونك في الحق بعد ما تبين﴾: the clause is resumptive, with no grammatical position; or a second ḥāl (circumstantial) of the ك, i.e.: He brought you out in the state of their disputing with you; or of the pronoun in كارهون, i.e.: averse in the state of disputing. في الحق is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) يجادلونك; بعد is an adverb of time attached to يجادلونك; ما is maṣdariyya, and it and what falls in its scope are a maṣdar (verbal noun) in the genitive by the adverb's being annexed to it, i.e.: after its becoming clear and its emergence.
﴿كأنما يساقون إلى الموت وهم ينظرون﴾: the clause is a ḥāl of the pronoun in ﴿لكارهون﴾, i.e.: in the state of their being likened to those who are driven to killing; كأنما is the restraining (kāffa) and restrained (makfūfa) particle; يساقون is an imperfect verb whose agent is not named (passive), and the و is the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent); إلى الموت is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to يساقون; the و is circumstantial (ḥāliyya); and هم ينظرون is a clause in the position of an accusative as a ḥāl.

muyesser-irab:7-7.t:
﴿وإذ يعدكم الله إحدى الطائفتين﴾: the و is resumptive; ﴿إذ﴾ is a noun indeclinable (mabnī) on the sukūn, in the position of an accusative as the mafʿūl bihi (direct object) of an omitted verb, its implied form being اذكر or اذكروا (remember); the clause ﴿يعدكم الله﴾ is in the position of a genitive as muḍāf ilayhi; إحدى الطائفتين is the mafʿūl bihi; and an omitted element must be supposed, i.e.: victory over one of the two parties.
﴿أنها لكم وتودون أن غير ذات الشوكة تكون لكم﴾: ﴿أنها﴾: أن is an abrogating particle (inna and its sisters) and ﴿ها﴾ is the noun of أن; ﴿لكم﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) the omitted khabar (predicate) of أن; and the interpreted maṣdar from ﴿أنها لكم﴾ is a badal (substitute) of inclusion (badal ishtimāl) for إحدى الطائفتين. تودون: the و is circumstantial (ḥāliyya), or a conjunction; تودون is an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ), the sign of its nominative being the retention of the nūn, and the و of the plural is the fāʿil (agent); the interpreted maṣdar from ﴿أن غير ذات الشوكة...﴾ is the object of تودّون; the clause ﴿تكون﴾ is the khabar of أن; and ﴿لكم﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to the omitted khabar of تكون.
﴿ويريد الله أن يحق الحق بكلماته ويقطع دابر الكافرين﴾: the و is a conjunction; يريد الله is a verb and its fāʿil; أن is maṣdariyya, and it with what falls in its scope is the object of يريد; بكلماته is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to يحق; and ويقطع دابر الكافرين is a conjoined clause.

muyesser-irab:8-8.t: ﴿ليحق الحق ويبطل الباطل ولو كره المجرمون﴾: the ل is of causation (taʿlīl); يحق is an imperfect verb, accusative (manṣūb) by an implied (muḍmara) أن; and the ل with what falls in its scope is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted element, its implied form being: He did that in order to establish the truth and nullify falsehood.

muyesser-irab:9-9.t:
﴿إذ تستغيثون ربكم﴾: ﴿إذ﴾ is a noun indeclinable (mabnī) on the sukūn, in the position of an accusative as a badal (substitute) for ﴿إذ﴾ in His saying, Exalted is He, ﴿وإذ يعدكم﴾; or in the position of an accusative as the mafʿūl bihi (direct object) of an omitted verb, its implied form being اذكر or اذكروا; or an adverb attached to (mutaʿalliq) the verb ﴿يُحق﴾ in the previous ayah. The clause ﴿تستغيثون﴾ is in the position of a genitive as muḍāf ilayhi; تستغيثون is an imperfect verb, and the و of the plural is the fāʿil (agent); and ربكم is the object of تستغيثون.
﴿فاستجاب لكم أني ممدكم بألف من الملائكة مردفين﴾: the ف is a conjunction; لكم is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to استجاب; أن and what falls in its scope are in the position of an accusative by removal of the preposition, i.e.: يأتي ممدكم [Translator's note: so in the source; the intended paraphrase is evidently بأني ممدكم "with [the news] that I will reinforce you"], and the preposition and its genitive noun are likewise attached to استجاب; ممدكم is the khabar (predicate) of أن; بألف is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ممدكم; من الملائكة is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted naʿt (adjective) of ألف; مردفين is a second naʿt; and the object of مردفين is omitted, because it is an active participle, i.e.: others like them (أمثالهم).

muyesser-irab:10-10.t:
﴿وما جعله الله إلا بشرى﴾: the و is resumptive and the clause after it is resumptive, with no grammatical position; or the و is a conjunction to what precedes. ما is negative; جعله الله is a verb, its mafʿūl bihi (direct object) and its fāʿil (agent), and the pronoun refers to the reinforcement; إلا is a particle of restriction (ḥaṣr); and بشرى is a mafʿūl li-ajlihi (object of purpose), excepted.
﴿ولتطمئن به قلوبكم﴾: the و is a conjunction; the ل is of causation (taʿlīl); تطمئن is an imperfect verb, accusative (manṣūb) by an implied أن after it, and أن with the verb is interpreted as a maṣdar (verbal noun) in the genitive by the ل; the preposition and its genitive noun are conjoined to بشرى. The object of purpose is put in the genitive with the ل here because a condition for the accusative is missing, namely: identity of the agent. قلوبكم is the fāʿil of تطمئن.
﴿وما النصر إلا من عند الله﴾: the و is resumptive and the clause after it is resumptive, with no grammatical position; or the و is circumstantial (ḥāliyya) and the clause after it is in the position of an accusative as a ḥāl (circumstantial). ما is negative; النصر is the mubtadaʾ (subject); إلا is a particle of restriction; and من عند الله is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted khabar (predicate).
﴿إن الله عزيز حكيم﴾: the nominal clause is a causal explanation (taʿlīl) of what precedes.

muyesser-irab:11-11.t:
﴿إذ يغشيكم النعاس أمنة منه﴾: ﴿إذ﴾ is a noun indeclinable (mabnī) on the sukūn, in the position of an accusative as a second badal (substitute) for ﴿إذ﴾ in His saying, Exalted is He, ﴿وإذ يعدكم﴾, on the view that ﴿إذ تستغيثون﴾ is a badal; or in the position of an accusative as the mafʿūl bihi (direct object) of an omitted verb, its implied form being اذكر or اذكروا; or an adverb attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿النصر﴾ in the previous ayah. The clause ﴿يغشيكم النعاس﴾ is in the position of a genitive as muḍāf ilayhi; النعاس is the second object of يُغَشِّي; أمنة is a ḥāl (circumstantial) or a mafʿūl li-ajlihi (object of purpose); and منه is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted naʿt (adjective) of أمنة.
﴿وينزل عليكم من السماء ماء ليطهركم به﴾: the و is a conjunction; ينزل is conjoined to يغشيكم; عليكم is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ينزل, and likewise ﴿من السماء﴾; ماء is the mafʿūl bihi. ليطهركم: the ل is of causation (taʿlīl), and يطهركم is an imperfect verb, accusative (manṣūb) by an implied أن after it; the implied ﴿أن﴾ and the imperfect verb after it are interpreted as a maṣdar (verbal noun) in the genitive by the lām of causation, and the lām of causation and the interpreted maṣdar are attached to ﴿ينزل﴾; and به is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to يطهركم.
﴿ويذهب عنكم رجز الشيطان﴾: the و is a conjunction; يذهب: an imperfect verb, and its fāʿil (agent) is latent (mustatir), its implied form being "he" (هو); عنكم: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to يذهب; رجز: the mafʿūl bihi; and الشيطان: muḍāf ilayhi. The clause ﴿يذهب عنكم﴾ is conjoined to the clause ﴿ليطهركم﴾.
﴿وليربط على قلوبكم ويثبت به الأقدام﴾: the و is a conjunction; the ل is of causation; يربط: an imperfect verb, accusative by an implied أن after the lām of causation, and its fāʿil is latent, its implied form being "he" (هو); the implied ﴿أن﴾ and the imperfect verb after it are interpreted as a maṣdar in the genitive by the lām of causation, and the lām of causation and the interpreted maṣdar are attached to ﴿ينزل﴾; على قلوبكم: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿يربط﴾; and the clause ﴿ليربط﴾ is conjoined to the clause ﴿ليطهركم﴾. يثبت: likewise conjoined to ﴿ليطهركم﴾; به: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿يثبت﴾; and الأقدام: the mafʿūl bihi.

muyesser-irab:12-12.t:
﴿إذ يوحي ربك إلى الملائكة أني معكم﴾: ﴿إذ﴾ is an adverb attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿يثبت﴾, or an indeclinable noun in the position of an accusative as the mafʿūl bihi (direct object) of an omitted verb, its implied form being اذكر (remember); and it is said: a third badal (substitute) for ﴿إذ﴾ in His saying, Exalted is He, ﴿وإذ يعدكم﴾, considering ﴿إذ﴾ in the previous ayah a second badal. The clause ﴿يوحي ربك﴾ is in the position of a genitive as muḍāf ilayhi; إلى الملائكة is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to يوحي; أني and what falls in its scope are the object of يوحي; and معكم is an adverb attached to the omitted khabar (predicate) of أني.
﴿فثبتوا الذين آمنوا﴾: the ف is the faṣīḥa fāʾ; الذين is the mafʿūl bihi; and the clause آمنوا has no grammatical position, because it is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative.
﴿سألقي في قلوب الذين كفروا الرعب﴾: the clause is resumptive, with no grammatical position; في قلوب is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ألقي; الرعب is the mafʿūl bihi of ألقي; and the clause كفروا has no grammatical position, because it is the ṣila of the relative.
﴿فاضربوا فوق الأعناق واضربوا منهم كل بنان﴾: فاضربوا is an imperative verb and its fāʿil (agent); فوق is an adverb attached to اضربوا, and the mafʿūl bihi is omitted, i.e.: فاضربوهم فوق الأعناق; or ﴿فوق﴾ is a mafʿūl bihi by extension (ʿalā al-ittisāʿ).

muyesser-irab:13-13.t:
﴿ذلك بأنهم شاقوا الله ورسوله﴾: the demonstrative is the mubtadaʾ (subject); the clause شاقوا الله ورسوله is the khabar (predicate) of أن [Translator's note: the source does not state the khabar of the demonstrative; it is usually taken to be بأنهم…, i.e. the preposition and the interpreted maṣdar]; the Name of Majesty is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object), and رسوله is conjoined to it.
﴿ومن يشاقق الله ورسوله فإن الله شديد العقاب﴾: the و is resumptive; من is conditional, the mubtadaʾ; يشاقون [Translator's note: so in the source; the ayah has يشاقق] is the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ); the ف is linking; إن is an abrogating particle (inna and its sisters), the Name of Majesty is its noun and شديد العقاب is its khabar; the protasis and its apodosis are the khabar of ﴿من﴾; and the clause ﴿ومن يشاقق...﴾ is resumptive, with no grammatical position.

muyesser-irab:14-14.t: ﴿ذلكم فذوقوه وأن للكافرين عذاب النار﴾: the demonstrative is the mubtadaʾ (subject) and the khabar (predicate) is omitted, its implied form being: العقاب (the punishment); or the demonstrative is the khabar of an omitted mubtadaʾ, i.e.: العقاب ذلكم; or it is in the position of an accusative on the basis of ishtighāl (preoccupation of the verb), as when you say: زيدًا فاضربه. The ف is resumptive, and what follows it is resumptive speech with no grammatical position; أن is conjoined to ذلكم; للكافرين is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) the omitted fronted khabar of ﴿أن﴾; and عذاب النار is its postponed noun.

muyesser-irab:15-15.t:
﴿يا أيها الذين آمنوا﴾: يا: a particle of the vocative; أي: the one addressed (munādā), an intended indefinite (nakira maqṣūda), indeclinable (mabnī) on the ḍamma, in the position of an accusative; ها is for drawing attention (tanbīh); الذين is a naʿt (adjective) of ﴿أي﴾; آمنوا: a verb and its fāʿil (agent); and the clause آمنوا is the ṣila (relative clause) of الذين, with no grammatical position.
﴿إذا لقيتم الذين كفروا زحفا فلا تولوهم الأدبار﴾: إذا is an adverb for future time, containing the meaning of condition; the clause لقيتم is in the position of a genitive as muḍāf ilayhi; الذين is its object; the clause كفروا is the ṣila of الذين, with no grammatical position; زحفًا is a ḥāl (circumstantial) of الذين, i.e.: in the state of their advancing; and it is said: ﴿زحفًا﴾ is accusative as a maṣdar (verbal noun) by an omitted ḥāl, i.e.: زاحفين زحفًا (advancing an advance). The ف is linking; لا is prohibitive; تولوهم is an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) by لا, the و is the fāʿil, and the ه is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object); and الأدبار: the second mafʿūl bihi.

muyesser-irab:16-16.t:
﴿ومن يولهم يومئذ دبره﴾: the و is resumptive; من is conditional, the mubtadaʾ (subject); يولهم is a verb, a latent (mustatir) fāʿil (agent) and its first object; دبره is the second object of يولهم. ﴿يومئذ﴾: يوم: an adverb of time attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿يولهم﴾; إذٍ: a noun indeclinable (mabnī) on an implied sukūn, because the place is occupied by the tanwīn of compensation, in the position of a genitive as muḍāf ilayhi; and the tanwīn compensates for an omitted clause.
﴿إلا متحرفا لقتال أو متحيزا إلى فئة﴾: إلا is a particle of restriction (ḥaṣr) because a prohibition precedes, and متحرفًا is a ḥāl (circumstantial); or ﴿إلا﴾ is a particle of exception, and متحرفًا is excepted from the pronoun of the believers; لقتال is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿متحرفا﴾; and أو متحيزًا إلى فئة is conjoined to what precedes it.
﴿فقد باء بغضب من الله﴾: the ف links the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ), because the apodosis is joined with قد; باء: a past verb; بغضب is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to باء or to an omitted ḥāl; من الله is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted naʿt (adjective); and the clause is in the position of a jussive as the apodosis. The clause ﴿ومن يولهم...﴾ is resumptive, with no grammatical position.
﴿ومأواه جهنم وبئس المصير﴾: the و is resumptive and the clause after it is resumptive, with no grammatical position; or the و is a conjunction and the clause after it is conjoined. مأواه is the mubtadaʾ and جهنم is its khabar (predicate); بئس is a rigid (jāmid) past verb for expressing blame; المصير is the fāʿil of بئس; and the one specified for blame (al-makhṣūṣ bil-dhamm) is omitted, i.e.: مصيرهم (their destination).

muyesser-irab:17-17.t:
﴿فلم تقتلوهم ولكن الله قتلهم﴾: the ف is the faṣīḥa fāʾ; لم is a particle of negation, conversion (to the past) and jussive; تقتلوهم is an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) by لم; the و is a particle of conjunction; لكن is an abrogating particle (inna and its sisters), الله is its noun, and the clause قتلهم is its khabar (predicate).
﴿وما رميت إذ رميت ولكن الله رمى﴾: conjoined to what precedes; ما is negative; ﴿إذ﴾ is an adverb for past time, attached to (mutaʿalliq) the negated verb ﴿رميت﴾; the second clause ﴿رميت﴾ is in the position of a genitive as muḍāf ilayhi; the و is a conjunction; لكن is an abrogating particle, the Name of Majesty is its noun, and the clause رمى is its khabar.
﴿وليبلي المؤمنين منه بلاء حسنا﴾: the و is a conjunction; the ل is of causation (taʿlīl); يبلي is an imperfect verb, accusative (manṣūb) by an implied أن, and أن with what falls in its scope is in the position of a genitive by the ل; the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to an omitted verb, its implied form being: فَعَلَ ذلك (He did that); المؤمنين is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object); بلاء is a mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object); and حسنًا is a naʿt (adjective) of ﴿بلاء﴾, accusative.
﴿إن الله سميع عليم﴾: conjoined to what precedes; إن is an abrogating particle, the Name of Majesty is its noun, and سميع عليم are its two khabars.

muyesser-irab:18-18.t: ﴿ذلكم وأن الله موهن كيد الكافرين﴾: the demonstrative is the mubtadaʾ (subject) and its khabar (predicate) is omitted, i.e.: ذلكم الإبلاء حق (that trial is true); أن and what falls in its scope are conjoined to ذلك; موهن is the khabar of ﴿أن﴾, and كيد الكافرين is muḍāf ilayhi. Or ﴿أن﴾ and what falls in its scope are conjoined to ﴿وليبلي﴾, or are in the position of an accusative by an implied verb, i.e.: واعلموا أن الله (and know that Allah).

muyesser-irab:19-19.t:
﴿إن تستفتحوا فقد جاءكم الفتح﴾: إن is conditional; تستفتحوا is an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) because it is the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ); the ف is linking because the apodosis is joined with قد; قد is a particle of realisation (taḥqīq); and جاءكم الفتح is a verb, its mafʿūl bihi (direct object) and its fāʿil (agent).
﴿وإن تنتهوا فهو خير لكم﴾: conjoined to what precedes, and the i'rab is like what came before it; the apodosis is joined with the ف because it is a nominal clause made up of a mubtadaʾ (subject) and a khabar (predicate). The apodosis clause in both places is in the position of a jussive.
﴿وإن تعودوا نعد﴾: also conjoined, and the apodosis clause has no grammatical position.
﴿ولن تغني عنكم فئتكم شيئا ولو كثرت﴾: also conjoined; لن is for negation, the accusative and the future; تغني is accusative (manṣūb) by لن; عنكم is attached to (mutaʿalliq) تغني; فئتكم is the fāʿil of تغني and a muḍāf ilayhi; شيئًا is a substitute for the mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object), because it is an attribute of the maṣdar, or a mafʿūl bihi; the و is circumstantial (ḥāliyya); لو is conditional; كثرت is the protasis; and the apodosis is omitted.
﴿وأن الله مع المؤمنين﴾: also conjoined; the hamza of ﴿أن﴾ has fatḥa by supposing the ل, the implied form being: ولأن الله مع المؤمنين (and because Allah is with the believers); the Name of Majesty is the noun of أن; and مع is an adverb of place attached to an omitted element, which is the khabar.

muyesser-irab:20-20.t:
﴿يا أيها الذين آمنوا﴾: يا: a particle of the vocative; أي: the one addressed (munādā), an intended indefinite (nakira maqṣūda), indeclinable (mabnī) on the ḍamma, in the position of an accusative; ها is for drawing attention (tanbīh); الذين is a naʿt (adjective) of ﴿أي﴾; آمنوا: a verb and its fāʿil (agent); and the clause آمنوا is the ṣila (relative clause) of الذين, with no grammatical position.
﴿أطيعوا الله ورسوله ولا تولوا عنه وأنتم تسمعون﴾: أطيعوا is an imperative verb and its fāʿil (agent); الله is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object); رسوله is conjoined to the Name of Majesty; the clause ولا تولوا is conjoined to the clause أطيعوا; لا is prohibitive; تولوا is an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) by the prohibitive لا, and the و is the fāʿil; عنه is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) تولوا; وأنتم: the و is circumstantial (ḥāliyya), أنتم is the mubtadaʾ (subject), and the clause تسمعون is the khabar (predicate).

muyesser-irab:21-21.t: ﴿ولا تكونوا كالذين قالوا سمعنا وهم لا يسمعون﴾: conjoined to what precedes; ﴿لا﴾ is prohibitive; ﴿تكونوا﴾ is a verb, jussive (majzūm) by لا, the sign of its jussive being the dropping of the nūn; it is a defective verb (kāna and its sisters), and the و of the plural is the noun of تكون. ﴿كالذين﴾: the ك is a noun in the sense of مثل (like), indeclinable (mabnī) on the fatḥa, in the position of an accusative as the khabar (predicate) of ﴿تكون﴾; الذين: a relative noun in the position of a genitive as muḍāf ilayhi; the clause ﴿قالوا﴾ is the ṣila (relative clause) of الذين, with no grammatical position; the clause ﴿سمعنا﴾ is the object of saying (maqūl al-qawl); the و is circumstantial (ḥāliyya); and the clause ﴿هم لا يسمعون﴾ is in the position of an accusative as a ḥāl (circumstantial).

muyesser-irab:22-22.t: ﴿إن شر الدواب عند الله الصم البكم الذين لا يعقلون﴾: إن is an abrogating particle (inna and its sisters); شر is its noun; ﴿عند الله﴾ is an adverb attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial); الصم is the khabar (predicate) of إن; إليكم is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted second khabar [Translator's note: so in the source; there is no إليكم in this ayah, apparently carried over from elsewhere; the word in that position is البكم, which is presumably meant as a second khabar]; الذين is a naʿt (adjective); and the clause لا يعقلون is the ṣila (relative clause) of الذين, with no grammatical position.

muyesser-irab:23-23.t:
﴿ولو علم الله فيهم خيرا لأسمعهم﴾: the و is resumptive; لو is a particle of non-occurrence because of non-occurrence (imtināʿ li-imtināʿ), containing the meaning of condition; علم الله is a verb and its fāʿil (agent); فيهم is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) علم; خيرًا is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object). لأسمعهم: the ل links the apodosis of لو, and أسمعهم is a verb and a latent (mustatir) fāʿil, and the ه is the mafʿūl bihi; and the clause ﴿ولو علم الله...﴾ is resumptive, with no grammatical position.
﴿ولو أسمعهم لتولوا وهم معرضون﴾: the و is a conjunction; لو is merely for linking, and it cannot be the لو of non-occurrence, because the meaning would become: their turning away did not happen because their being made to hear did not happen, and this is contrary to the fact; so it is here merely for linking, in the sense of إن. أسمعهم is a past verb and the ه is the mafʿūl bihi; لتولوا: the ل is linking, and تولوا is a past verb and its fāʿil; the و is circumstantial (ḥāliyya); هم معرضون is a mubtadaʾ (subject) and khabar (predicate); and the clause is circumstantial.

muyesser-irab:24-24.t:
﴿يا أيها الذين آمنوا﴾: يا: a particle of the vocative; أي: the one addressed (munādā), an intended indefinite (nakira maqṣūda), indeclinable (mabnī) on the ḍamma, in the position of an accusative; ها is for drawing attention (tanbīh); الذين is a naʿt (adjective) of ﴿أي﴾; آمنوا: a verb and its fāʿil (agent); and the clause آمنوا is the ṣila (relative clause) of الذين, with no grammatical position.
﴿استجيبوا لله وللرسول إذا دعاكم لما يحييكم﴾: استجيبوا is an imperative verb and its fāʿil (agent); لله is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) استجيبوا; للرسول is conjoined to الله; إذا is a future adverb; the clause دعاكم is in the position of a genitive as muḍāf ilayhi; لما is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to دعاكم; and the clause يحييكم is the ṣila (relative clause) of ﴿ما﴾, with no grammatical position.
﴿واعلموا أن الله يحول بين المرء وقلبه﴾: the و is a conjunction; اعلموا is conjoined to استجيبوا; أن and what falls in its scope stand in place of the two objects of اعلموا; the clause يحول is the khabar (predicate) of أن; بين is an adverb attached to يحول; المرء is muḍāf ilayhi; and قلبه is conjoined to المرء.
﴿وأنه إليه تحشرون﴾: conjoined to ﴿أن الله﴾; إليه is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to تحشرون; and the clause تحشرون is the khabar of أن.

muyesser-irab:25-25.t:
﴿واتقوا فتنة لا تصيبن الذين ظلموا منكم خاصة﴾: the و is a conjunction; اتقوا is conjoined to استجيبوا; فتنة is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the clause لا تصيبن is a naʿt (adjective) of فتنة, and ﴿لا﴾ is negative. Or the clause is governed by an omitted saying, and ﴿لا﴾ is prohibitive, and that saying is the naʿt, i.e.: a trial of which it is said: let it not strike (لا تصيبن). الذين is the mafʿūl bihi; the clause ظلموا is the ṣila (relative clause) of الذين, with no grammatical position; ﴿منكم﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial); and ﴿خاصة﴾ is accusative as a ḥāl of the latent (mustatir) fāʿil (agent) in His saying لا تصيبن; it was originally a naʿt of an omitted maṣdar (verbal noun), its implied form being: إصابة خاصة (a specific striking).
﴿واعلموا أن الله شديد العقاب﴾: the و is a conjunction; اعلموا is likewise conjoined; أن is an abrogating particle (inna and its sisters), the Name of Majesty is its noun, and شديد is its khabar (predicate); أن and what falls in its scope stand in place of the two objects of علم; and العقاب is muḍāf ilayhi.

muyesser-irab:26-26.t:
﴿واذكروا إذ أنتم قليل مستضعفون في الأرض﴾: the و is a conjunction; اذكروا is conjoined to استجيبوا; ﴿إذ﴾ is a noun indeclinable (mabnī) on the sukūn, in the position of an accusative as the mafʿūl bihi (direct object) of the verb اذكروا, i.e.: remember the time of your being few and oppressed; the clause ﴿أنتم قليل...﴾ is in the position of a genitive as muḍāf ilayhi; أنتم: the mubtadaʾ (subject); قليل: the khabar (predicate) of the mubtadaʾ; مستضعفون: a second khabar; and في الأرض is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿مستضعفون﴾.
﴿تخافون أن يتخطفكم الناس﴾: تخافون: an imperfect verb, and the و of the plural is the fāʿil (agent); the clause ﴿تخافون﴾ is in the position of a nominative as a third khabar of the mubtadaʾ; the interpreted maṣdar from ﴿أن يتخطفكم﴾ is the object of تخافون; and الناس is the fāʿil of يتخطفكم.
﴿فآواكم وأيدكم بنصره ورزقكم من الطيبات لعلكم تشكرون﴾: the ف is a conjunction; آواكم is a past verb and a latent (mustatir) fāʿil, and what follows is conjoined to it; لعل is an abrogating particle (inna and its sisters), the ك is its noun, and the clause ﴿تشكرون﴾ is its khabar.

muyesser-irab:27-27.t:
﴿يا أيها الذين آمنوا﴾: يا: a particle of the vocative; أي: the one addressed (munādā), an intended indefinite (nakira maqṣūda), indeclinable (mabnī) on the ḍamma, in the position of an accusative; ها is for drawing attention (tanbīh); الذين is a naʿt (adjective) of ﴿أي﴾; آمنوا: a verb and its fāʿil (agent); and the clause آمنوا is the ṣila (relative clause) of الذين, with no grammatical position.
﴿لا تخونوا الله والرسول﴾: لا is prohibitive; تخونوا is an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) by the prohibitive لا, and the و is the fāʿil; the Name of Majesty is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object); and الرسول is conjoined to the Name of Majesty.
﴿وتخونوا أماناتكم وأنتم تعلمون﴾: the و is of accompaniment (maʿiyya), and ﴿تخونوا﴾ is accusative (manṣūb) by an implied أن after it, because it falls as an answer to the prohibition; or the و is a conjunction and ﴿تخونوا﴾ is jussive, falling under the ruling of the prohibition. أماناتكم is the mafʿūl bihi on the supposition of an omitted element, i.e.: the owners of your trusts; وأنتم: the و is for the ḥāl, أنتم is the mubtadaʾ (subject), the clause تعلمون is the khabar (predicate), and the clause أنتم تعلمون is circumstantial (ḥāliyya); the object of يعلمون is omitted because it is known, i.e.: you know that what happened on your part is treachery.

muyesser-irab:28-28.t: ﴿واعلموا أنما أموالكم وأولادكم فتنة وأن الله عنده أجر عظيم﴾: the و is a conjunction; اعلموا is conjoined to what precedes; أنما is the restraining (kāffa) and restrained (makfūfa) particle, and it stands in place of the two objects of اعلموا, which is why its hamza has fatḥa; أموالكم is the mubtadaʾ (subject); أولادكم is conjoined to ﴿أموالكم﴾; فتنة is the khabar (predicate); وأن الله is conjoined to أنما أموالكم وأولادكم; أن is an abrogating particle (inna and its sisters) and the Name of Majesty is its noun; ﴿عنده﴾ is an adverb, the fronted khabar; أجر is the postponed mubtadaʾ; and the clause is the khabar of ﴿أن﴾.

muyesser-irab:29-29.t:
﴿يا أيها الذين آمنوا﴾: يا: a particle of the vocative; أي: the one addressed (munādā), an intended indefinite (nakira maqṣūda), indeclinable (mabnī) on the ḍamma, in the position of an accusative; ها is for drawing attention (tanbīh); الذين is a naʿt (adjective) of ﴿أي﴾; آمنوا: a verb and its fāʿil (agent); and the clause آمنوا is the ṣila (relative clause) of الذين, with no grammatical position.
﴿إن تتقوا الله يجعل لكم فرقانا﴾: إن is conditional; تتقوا is the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ); لكم is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) يجعل; and فرقانًا is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object).
﴿ويكفر عنكم سيئاتكم ويغفر لكم﴾: conjoined to what precedes.
﴿والله ذو الفضل العظيم﴾: the و is resumptive. الله is the mubtadaʾ (subject); ذو الفضل is its khabar (predicate); العظيم is a naʿt of الفضل; and the clause is resumptive, with no grammatical position.

muyesser-irab:30-30.t:
﴿وإذ يمكر بك الذين كفروا ليثبتوك أو يقتلوك أو يخرجوك﴾: ﴿إذ﴾ is a noun indeclinable (mabnī) on the sukūn, in the position of an accusative as the mafʿūl bihi (direct object) of an omitted verb, its implied form being اذكر (remember); the meaning is: and remember, O Muhammad, the time of their plotting against you. The clause ﴿يمكر﴾ is in the position of a genitive as muḍāf ilayhi; بك is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) يمكر; الذين is the fāʿil (agent) of يمكر; the clause كفروا is the ṣila (relative clause), with no grammatical position; the ل is of causation (taʿlīl); يثبتوك is accusative (manṣūb) by an implied أن after the lām of causation, and أن with the verb is interpreted as a maṣdar (verbal noun) in the genitive by the ل, the preposition and its genitive noun being attached to يمكر; أو يقتلوك is conjoined to it, and أو يخرجوك is likewise conjoined.
﴿ويمكرون ويمكر الله والله خير الماكرين﴾: the و is resumptive; يمكرون is an imperfect verb and the و is the fāʿil; ويمكر الله is conjoined; الله is the mubtadaʾ (subject) and خير الماكرين is its khabar (predicate); and the clause ﴿ويمكرون ويمكر الله﴾ is resumptive, with no grammatical position.

muyesser-irab:31-31.t:
﴿وإذا تتلى عليهم آياتنا قالوا قد سمعنا﴾: the و is resumptive, and the clause after it is resumptive, with no grammatical position; إذا is a future adverb containing the meaning of condition; the clause تتلى is that to which the adverb is annexed (muḍāf ilayhi); عليهم is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) تتلى; آياتنا is the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent); the clause قالوا has no grammatical position, because it is the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) of a non-jussive condition; and the clause قد سمعنا is the object of saying (maqūl al-qawl).
﴿لو نشاء لقلنا مثل هذا﴾: لو is conditional; نشاء is the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ); the ل is linking; the clause قلنا has no [grammatical] position, because it is the apodosis of a non-jussive condition; and مثل is a substitute for the mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object), because it is an attribute of the maṣdar, i.e.: a saying like this (قولا مثل هذا).
﴿إن هذا إلا أساطير الأولين﴾: إن is negative; هذا is the mubtadaʾ (subject); إلا is a particle of restriction (ḥaṣr); and أساطير الأولين is the khabar (predicate) of هذا.

muyesser-irab:32-32.t:
﴿وإذ قالوا اللهم إن كان هذا هو الحق من عندك﴾: ﴿إذ﴾ is a noun indeclinable (mabnī) on the sukūn, in the position of an accusative as the mafʿūl bihi (direct object) of an omitted verb, its implied form being اذكر (remember); the clause ﴿قالوا﴾ is in the position of a genitive as muḍāf ilayhi; اللهم is a singular proper-name munādā (the one addressed), from which ﴿يا﴾ has been dropped and replaced by the doubled mīm; إن is conditional; كان is a defective past verb (kāna and its sisters), in the position of a jussive as the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ); هذا is its noun; هو is a pronoun of separation (ḍamīr faṣl); الحق is the khabar (predicate) of كان; and من عندك is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial).
﴿فأمطر علينا حجارة من السماء﴾: the ف is linking; أمطر is a verb of supplication; علينا is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to أمطر; حجارة is the mafʿūl bihi; من السماء is a naʿt (adjective) of حجارة; and the clause is in the position of a jussive as the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ).
﴿أو ائتنا بعذاب أليم﴾: أو is a particle of conjunction; ائت is a verb of supplication, indeclinable on the dropping of the weak letter, and the fāʿil (agent) is latent (mustatir); بعذاب is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ائتنا; and أليم is a naʿt.

muyesser-irab:33-33.t:
﴿وما كان الله ليعذبهم وأنت فيهم﴾: the و is resumptive, and the clause after it is resumptive, with no grammatical position; ما is negative; كان is a defective, abrogating past verb (kāna and its sisters), and the Name of Majesty is its noun; the ل is the lām of denial (lām al-juḥūd); يعذبهم is accusative (manṣūb) by an implied أن after the lām of denial, and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to (mutaʿalliq) the omitted khabar (predicate) of كان; وأنت فيهم: the و is for the ḥāl, and the nominal clause made of the mubtadaʾ (subject) and khabar is circumstantial (ḥāliyya).
﴿وما كان الله معذبهم وهم يستغفرون﴾: conjoined to the previous clause; and هم يستغفرون is in the place of a ḥāl (circumstantial).

muyesser-irab:34-34.t:
﴿وما لهم ألا يعذبهم الله﴾: the و is a conjunction; ما is an interrogative noun of disapproval, for negation, the mubtadaʾ (subject); لهم is the khabar (predicate); and أنّ and what falls in its scope are a maṣdar, accusative by removal of the preposition, attached to (mutaʿalliq) what the preceding preposition and its genitive noun are attached to, or to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial).
﴿وهم يصدون عن المسجد الحرام﴾: the و is for the ḥāl, and the clause هم يصدون is circumstantial (ḥāliyya).
﴿وما كانوا أولياءه﴾: the و is a conjunction, or circumstantial; كانوا is a defective, abrogating past verb (kāna and its sisters), the و is its noun, and أولياءه is its khabar.
﴿إن أولياؤه إلا المتقون﴾: إن is negative; أولياؤه is the mubtadaʾ; إلا is a particle of restriction (ḥaṣr); and المتقون is the khabar of ﴿أولياءه﴾ [Translator's note: so spelled in the source; the word here is أولياؤه].
﴿ولكن أكثرهم لا يعلمون﴾: لكن is an abrogating particle (inna and its sisters), أكثرهم is its noun, and the clause is its khabar; the و is circumstantial and the clause after it is in the position of an accusative as a ḥāl, or the و is resumptive and the clause after it is resumptive, with no grammatical position.

muyesser-irab:35-35.t:
﴿وما كان صلاتهم عند البيت إلا مكاء وتصدية﴾: the و is resumptive, or a conjunction; ما is negative; كان is a defective, abrogating past verb (kāna and its sisters); صلاتهم is its noun; عند البيت: the adverb is attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial); إلا is a particle of restriction (ḥaṣr); مكاء is the khabar (predicate) of كان; تصدية is conjoined to مكاء; and the clause ﴿وما كان صلاتهم...﴾ is resumptive, with no grammatical position, or conjoined.
﴿فذوقوا العذاب بما كنتم تكفرون﴾: the ف is the faṣīḥa fāʾ; ذوقوا is an imperative verb and its fāʿil (agent); العذاب is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the ب is causal (sababiyya); and ما is maṣdariyya, i.e.: because of your disbelief.

muyesser-irab:36-36.t:
﴿إن الذين كفروا ينفقون أموالهم ليصدوا عن سبيل الله﴾: إن is an abrogating particle (inna and its sisters); الذين is its noun; the clause كفروا is the ṣila (relative clause) of الذين, with no grammatical position; the clause ينفقون أموالهم is the khabar (predicate) of الذين [Translator's note: so in the source; i.e. the khabar of إن, whose noun is الذين]. ليصدوا: the ل is of causation (taʿlīl); يصدوا is an imperfect verb, accusative (manṣūb) by an implied أن, and أن with the verb is interpreted as a maṣdar (verbal noun) in the genitive, the preposition and its genitive noun being attached to (mutaʿalliq) ينفقون; the و is the fāʿil (agent); and عن سبيل الله is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to يصدوا.
﴿فسينفقونها ثم تكون عليهم حسرة ثم يغلبون﴾: the ف is a conjunction; the س is a particle of the future; ينفقونها is an imperfect verb, its fāʿil and its mafʿūl bihi (direct object); ثم is a particle of conjunction for delay and sequence; ﴿تكون﴾ is conjoined to ينفقونها, and its noun is latent (mustatir), its implied form being "it" (هي); ﴿عليهم﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial), because it was originally a naʿt (adjective) of ﴿حسرة﴾ and was placed before it; ﴿حسرة﴾ is the khabar of ﴿تكون﴾; ﴿ثم يغلبون﴾ is conjoined to ﴿ثم تكون﴾, and the و is the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent).
﴿والذين كفروا إلى جهنم يحشرون﴾: الذين is the mubtadaʾ (subject); كفروا is the ṣila of الذين, with no grammatical position; the clause يحشرون is the khabar of الذين; and إلى جهنم is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to يحشرون.

muyesser-irab:37-37.t:
﴿ليميز الله الخبيث من الطيب﴾: the ل is of causation (taʿlīl); يميز is accusative (manṣūb) by an implied أن, and أن with the verb is interpreted as a maṣdar (verbal noun) in the genitive by the ل, the preposition and its genitive noun being attached to (mutaʿalliq) one of the preceding verbs; الله is the fāʿil (agent); الخبيث is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object); and من الطيب is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to يميز.
﴿ويجعل الخبيث بعضه على بعض﴾: the و is a conjunction; يجعل is conjoined to يميز; الخبيث is the object; بعضه is a badal (substitute) for الخبيث, a substitute of part for whole; and على بعض is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial), or in the position of an accusative as the second mafʿūl bihi of يجعل, the implied form being: and He makes some of the wicked high upon others.
﴿فيركمه جميعا فيجعله في جهنم﴾: the ف is a conjunction; يركمه is conjoined to يجعل, and the ه is its object; جميعًا is a ḥāl of the ه in يركمه, or a tawkīd (emphasis) of it; فيجعله is conjoined to يركمه; and في جهنم is the second mafʿūl bihi.
﴿أولئك هم الخاسرون﴾: the clause is a mubtadaʾ (subject) and khabar (predicate), and هم is a pronoun of separation (ḍamīr faṣl); or they are a first and second mubtadaʾ, الخاسرون is the khabar of the second, and the nominal clause is the khabar of أولئك.

muyesser-irab:38-38.t:
﴿قل للذين كفروا إن ينتهوا يغفر لهم ما قد سلف﴾: the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to (mutaʿalliq) قل; إن is conditional; ينتهوا is the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ); يغفر, in the passive form, is the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ); لهم is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to يغفر; ما is a relative noun, the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent); and the clause قد سلف is the ṣila (relative clause) of ﴿ما﴾, with no grammatical position.
﴿وإن يعودوا فقد مضت سنت الأولين﴾: the و is a conjunction; إن is conditional; يعودوا is the protasis, and what it is attached to is omitted, i.e.: to fighting him or to disbelief, and both are meant; فقد: the ف links the apodosis, and قد is a particle of realisation (taḥqīq); and مضت سنة الأولين is a verb, its fāʿil (agent) and a muḍāf ilayhi.

muyesser-irab:39-39.t:
﴿وقاتلوهم حتى لا تكون فتنة ويكون الدين كله لله﴾: conjoined to قل للذين; حتى is a particle of limit and of the genitive; لا is negative; ﴿تكون﴾ is accusative (manṣūb) by an implied أن after حتى, and أن with the verb is interpreted as a maṣdar (verbal noun) in the genitive by حتى, the preposition and its genitive noun being attached to (mutaʿalliq) قاتلوهم; ﴿تكون﴾ here is complete (tāmma), and فتنة is the fāʿil (agent); ﴿يكون﴾ is conjoined to ﴿تكون﴾, and here it is defective (nāqiṣa); الدين is its noun, كله is a tawkīd (emphasis), and لله is the khabar (predicate).
﴿فإن انتهوا فإن الله بما يعملون بصير﴾: the ف is a conjunction; إن is conditional; انتهوا is a past verb in the position of a jussive as the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ); the ف is linking; إن is an abrogating particle (inna and its sisters), the Name of Majesty is its noun, and بصير is its khabar; بما يعملون is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to بصير; and the clause يعملون is the ṣila (relative clause) of ﴿ما﴾, with no grammatical position.

muyesser-irab:40-40.t: ﴿وإن تولوا فاعلموا أن الله مولاكم نعم المولى ونعم النصير﴾: conjoined to what precedes it; ﴿إن﴾ is conditional; ﴿تولوا﴾ is a past verb in the position of a jussive as the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ); the ف is causal (taʿlīliyya) or links the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ); ﴿اعلموا﴾ is an imperative verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the dropping of the nūn, and the و is the fāʿil (agent); the clause ﴿اعلموا﴾ is a causal explanation of the omitted apodosis, i.e.: if they turn away, do not fear their might, because Allah is your protector; or it is in the position of a jussive as the apodosis. أن and what falls in its scope stand in place of the two objects of ﴿اعلموا﴾; ﴿نعم﴾ is a rigid (jāmid) past verb for expressing praise; المولى is the fāʿil; the one specified for praise (al-makhṣūṣ bil-madḥ) is omitted, i.e.: هو (He); and likewise ﴿ونعم النصير﴾.

muyesser-irab:41-41.t:
﴿واعلموا أنما غنمتم من شيء﴾: the و is resumptive; اعلموا is a verb and its fāʿil (agent); أن and what falls in its scope stand in place of the two objects of اعلموا; ما is a relative; the clause غنمتم is the ṣila (relative clause) of ﴿ما﴾, with no grammatical position; and من شيء is in the position of an accusative as a ḥāl (circumstantial) of the implied (muqaddar) returning pronoun of the relative; the meaning is: whatever you have taken as spoils, being of any thing, i.e.: whether it be little or much.
﴿فأن لله خمسه وللرسول ولذي القربى واليتامى والمساكين وابن السبيل﴾: the ف is linking; أن and what falls in its scope are the khabar (predicate) of an omitted mubtadaʾ (subject), its implied form being: فحكمه أن لله خمسه (its ruling is that to Allah belongs a fifth of it); the preposition and its genitive noun are the fronted khabar of أن, and خمسه is its postponed noun, the implied form being: فأن خمسه لله. Or ﴿أن﴾ and what falls in its scope are a mubtadaʾ whose khabar is omitted, its implied form being: فحق, or فواجب, أن لله خمسه (then it is a right, or obligatory, that to Allah belongs a fifth of it). ﴿للرسول﴾ and what follows it are conjoined to His saying ﴿لله﴾; and the clause ﴿واعلموا أنما غنمتم...﴾ is resumptive, with no grammatical position.
﴿إن كنتم آمنتم بالله وما أنزلنا على عبدنا يوم الفرقان﴾: إن is conditional; كنتم is the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ), and the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) is omitted, its implied form being: فاعلموا ذلك (then know that); the clause آمنتم is the khabar of كنتم; بالله is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) آمنتم; ما is conjoined to الله; the clause أنزلنا is the ṣila of ﴿ما﴾, with no grammatical position; على عبدنا is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to أنزلنا; and يوم الفرقان is an adverb, likewise attached to أنزلنا.
﴿يوم التقى الجمعان﴾: the adverb is a badal (substitute) for the first adverb, and the clause التقى الجمعان is in the position of a genitive by the adverb's being annexed to it.
﴿والله على كل شيء قدير﴾: the و is resumptive; الله is the mubtadaʾ and قدير is its khabar; على كل شيء is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to قدير; and the clause is resumptive, with no grammatical position.

muyesser-irab:42-42.t:
﴿إذ أنتم بالعدوة الدنيا وهم بالعدوة القصوى﴾: ﴿إذ﴾ is a second badal (substitute) for ﴿يوم الفرقان﴾ in the previous ayah; أنتم is the mubtadaʾ (subject) and بالعدوة is the khabar (predicate), and the nominal clause is in the position of a genitive as muḍāf ilayhi; الدنيا is a naʿt (adjective) of العدوة; and وهم بالعدوة القصوى is conjoined to the one before it.
﴿والركب أسفل منكم﴾: the و is circumstantial (ḥāliyya), of the adverb, namely His saying ﴿بالعدوة القصوى﴾; or the و conjoins to ﴿أنتم﴾, because it is the beginning of the division of their states and the states of their enemy. الركب is the mubtadaʾ; أسفل is accusative as an adverb, in the position of a nominative as the khabar; منكم is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) أسفل, because it is originally an elative (ism tafḍīl) and was used in the sense of an attribute of an omitted place, and was put in its stead.
﴿ولو تواعدتم لاختلفتم في الميعاد﴾: the و is a conjunction; لو is conditional, the one indicating non-occurrence (imtināʿ); تواعدتم is the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ); and the ل is linking.
﴿ولكن ليقضي الله أمرا كان مفعولا﴾: لكن is a particle of rectification (istidrāk), inoperative (muhmal); ليقضي: the ل is of causation (taʿlīl), and يقضي is an imperfect verb, accusative (manṣūb) by an implied أن after the lām of causation; the interpreted maṣdar from the implied أن and the verb is in the genitive by the lām of causation, and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to an omitted element, i.e.: He gathered you without appointment; ﴿الله﴾ is the fāʿil (agent); أمرًا is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the clause ﴿كان مفعولا﴾ is a naʿt of ﴿أمرا﴾; ﴿كان﴾ is a defective, abrogating past verb (kāna and its sisters), its noun is latent (mustatir), and مفعولًا is its khabar.
﴿ليهلك من هلك عن بينة﴾: the ل is a preposition; يهلك is an imperfect verb, accusative by an implied أن after the ل; the interpreted maṣdar from أن and the verb is in the genitive by the ل, and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to what ﴿ليقضي﴾ is attached to, so it is a badal for it; or they are attached to ﴿مفعولا﴾. من is a relative noun, the fāʿil; the clause هلك is the ṣila (relative clause) of ﴿مَن﴾, with no grammatical position; and عن بينة is a ḥāl (circumstantial).
﴿ويحيا من حي عن بينة﴾: conjoined to the previous clause.
﴿وإن الله لسميع عليم﴾: the و is resumptive; إن is an abrogating particle (inna and its sisters) and the Name of Majesty is its noun; the ل is the shifted lām (al-lām al-muzaḥlaqa); سميع is the first khabar of ﴿إن﴾ and عليم a second khabar; and the clause is resumptive, with no grammatical position.

muyesser-irab:43-43.t:
﴿إذ يريكهم الله في منامك قليلا﴾: ﴿إذ﴾ is a third badal (substitute) for ﴿يوم الفرقان﴾, or a badal for the preceding ﴿إذ﴾, or a noun indeclinable (mabnī) on the sukūn in the position of an accusative as the mafʿūl bihi (direct object) of an omitted verb, its implied form being اذكر (remember). ﴿يريكهم﴾ is an imperfect verb; the ك is the first object and the ه the second object, and the م is the sign of the plural; ﴿الله﴾ is the fāʿil (agent); the clause ﴿يريكهم﴾ is in the position of a genitive as muḍāf ilayhi; ﴿في منامك﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿يريكهم﴾; and ﴿قليلا﴾ is a ḥāl (circumstantial) of the second object.
﴿ولو أراكهم كثيرا لفشلتم ولتنازعتم في الأمر﴾: the و is a conjunction; ﴿لو﴾ is conditional; ﴿أراكهم﴾ is a past verb, the ك is the first object, the ه the second object, and the م is the sign of the plural; ﴿كثيرًا﴾ is a ḥāl of the second object; ﴿لفشلتم﴾: the ل is linking, and فشلتم is a verb and its fāʿil; ﴿لتنازعتم﴾ is conjoined to لفشلتم; and ﴿في الأمر﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to تنازعتم.
﴿ولكن الله سلم إنه عليم بذات الصدور﴾: the و is a conjunction; ﴿لكن﴾ is an abrogating particle (inna and its sisters), the Name of Majesty is its noun, and the clause ﴿سلم﴾ is its khabar (predicate); ﴿إنه﴾: ﴿إن﴾ is an abrogating particle and the ه is its noun; ﴿عليم﴾ is the khabar of إن; ﴿بذات الصدور﴾: the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to عليم; and ﴿الصدور﴾ is muḍāf ilayhi.

muyesser-irab:44-44.t:
﴿وإذ يريكموهم إذ التقيتم في أعينكم قليلا﴾: ﴿إذ﴾ is conjoined to ﴿إذ﴾ in His saying, Exalted is He, ﴿إذ يريكهم﴾; يريكموهم is an imperfect verb, the ك is the first object, the م is the sign of the plural, the و is for lengthening the vowel of the م, and the ه is the second object; the clause ﴿يريكموهم﴾ is in the position of a genitive as muḍāf ilayhi; ﴿إذ﴾ is an adverb attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿يريكموهم﴾; the clause ﴿التقيتم﴾ is in the position of a genitive by the adverb's being annexed to it; في أعينكم is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿قليلا﴾; and قليلا is a ḥāl (circumstantial) of the ه, because the seeing here is visual, so with the hamza it puts only two objects in the accusative.
﴿ويقللكم في أعينهم ليقضي الله أمرا كان مفعولا﴾: conjoined to what precedes; في أعينهم is a ḥāl; ليقضي: the lām of causation together with what it governs is attached to يقللكم, because it is the reason for it; and the clause كان مفعولًا is a naʿt (adjective) of الأمر.
﴿وإلى الله ترجع الأمور﴾: the و is a conjunction; إلى الله is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ترجع; and الأمور is the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent).

muyesser-irab:45-45.t:
﴿يا أيها الذين آمنوا﴾: يا: a particle of the vocative; أي: the one addressed (munādā), an intended indefinite (nakira maqṣūda), indeclinable (mabnī) on the ḍamma, in the position of an accusative; ها is for drawing attention (tanbīh); الذين is a naʿt (adjective) of ﴿أي﴾; آمنوا: a verb and its fāʿil (agent); and the clause آمنوا is the ṣila (relative clause) of الذين, with no grammatical position.
﴿إذا لقيتم فئة فاثبتوا﴾: إذا is a particle [Translator's note: so in the source, حرف; elsewhere the book calls إذا an adverb] for future time, putting its protasis in the genitive and being itself accusative by its apodosis; the clause ﴿لقيتم﴾ is in the position of a genitive as muḍāf ilayhi; فئة is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the ف is linking; اثبتوا is an imperative verb and its fāʿil; and the clause has no grammatical position, because it is the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) of a non-jussive condition.
﴿واذكروا الله كثيرا لعلكم تفلحون﴾: the و is a conjunction; اذكروا is conjoined to اثبتوا, and it is an imperative verb and its fāʿil; the Name of Majesty is the mafʿūl bihi; كثيرًا is a substitute for the mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object), because it is an attribute of an omitted maṣdar, i.e.: ذكرًا كثيرًا (much remembrance), or a naʿt of an omitted adverb, i.e.: وقتًا كثيرًا (much time); ﴿لعلكم تفلحون﴾: لعل is an abrogating particle (inna and its sisters), the ك is its noun, and the clause تفلحون is its khabar (predicate).

muyesser-irab:46-46.t:
﴿وأطيعوا الله ورسوله ولا تنازعوا فتفشلوا وتذهب ريحكم﴾: the و is a conjunction; أطيعوا is conjoined to اذكروا; the Name of Majesty is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object), and رسوله is conjoined to it; لا is prohibitive; تنازعوا, originally تتنازعوا, is jussive (majzūm) by the prohibitive لا; the ف is the fāʾ of causation (sababiyya), because it falls in the answer to the prohibition; تفشلوا is an imperfect verb, accusative (manṣūb) by an implied أن after the fāʾ of causation, and أن with the verb is interpreted as a maṣdar (verbal noun) conjoined to a maṣdar understood from the preceding speech, i.e.: let there be among you no disputing and [so] failure. وتذهب ريحكم is conjoined to فتفشلوا. Or the ف is a conjunction and تفشلوا is jussive because it falls under the ruling of the prohibition.
﴿واصبروا إن الله مع الصابرين﴾: conjoined to what precedes; إن is an abrogating particle (inna and its sisters), the Name of Majesty is its noun, and the adverb is its khabar (predicate).

muyesser-irab:47-47.t:
﴿ولا تكونوا كالذين خرجوا من ديارهم بطرا ورئاء الناس﴾: the و is a conjunction; ولا تكونوا is conjoined to what precedes; تكونوا is a defective imperfect verb (kāna and its sisters), and the و of the plural is the noun of ﴿تكون﴾; ﴿كالذين﴾: the ك is a noun in the sense of مثل (like), indeclinable (mabnī) on the fatḥa, in the position of an accusative as the khabar (predicate) of ﴿تكون﴾; الذين: a relative noun in the position of a genitive as muḍāf ilayhi; بطرًا is a maṣdar (verbal noun) in the place of a ḥāl (circumstantial), or a mafʿūl li-ajlihi (object of purpose), and likewise رئاء الناس.
﴿ويصدون عن سبيل الله﴾: the و is a conjunction, and the clause يصدون is conjoined to بطرًا, i.e.: and [by way of] barring from the path of Allah (وصدًّا عن سبيل الله).
﴿والله بما يعملون محيط﴾: the و is resumptive; الله is the mubtadaʾ (subject) and محيط is its khabar; بما يعملون is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) محيط; and the clause is resumptive, with no grammatical position.

muyesser-irab:48-48.t:
﴿وإذ زين لهم الشيطان أعمالهم﴾: the و is a conjunction; ﴿إذ﴾ is a noun indeclinable (mabnī) on the sukūn, in the position of an accusative as the mafʿūl bihi (direct object) of an omitted verb, its implied form being اذكر or اذكروا (remember); the implied clause ﴿اذكر﴾ or ﴿اذكروا﴾ is conjoined to ﴿وإذ يريكموهم﴾; the clause ﴿زين﴾ is in the position of a genitive as muḍāf ilayhi; لهم is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) زين; الشيطان is the fāʿil (agent); and أعمالهم is the mafʿūl bihi.
﴿وقال لا غالب لكم اليوم من الناس﴾: the و is a conjunction; قال is conjoined to زين; لا is the lā of generic negation; غالب is its noun, indeclinable on the fatḥa; لكم is its khabar (predicate); and من الناس is a ḥāl (circumstantial) of the pronoun in لكم, because it contains the meaning of being settled (istiqrār).
﴿وإني جار لكم﴾: the و conjoins the clause that falls within the scope of the saying, which is why its hamza has kasra; إن is an abrogating particle (inna and its sisters), the ي is its noun, and جار is its khabar; ﴿لكم﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿جار﴾, because it is in the sense of مجير (protector).
﴿فلما تراءت الفئتان نكص على عقبيه﴾: the ف is a conjunction; لما is an adverb in the sense of حين (when), or linking; تراءت الفئتان is a verb and its fāʿil; نكص is conjoined to تراءت, and the clause has no grammatical position; and على عقبيه is a ḥāl.
﴿وقال إني بريء منكم﴾: the و is a conjunction; قال is conjoined to نكص; إن is an abrogating particle, the ي is its noun, and بريء is its khabar; منكم is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to بريء; and the clause is the object of saying (maqūl al-qawl).
﴿إني أرى ما لا ترون﴾: إن is an abrogating particle, the ي is its noun, and the clause أرى is its khabar; ما is the mafʿūl bihi; the clause لا ترون is the ṣila (relative clause) of ﴿ما﴾, with no grammatical position, and the returning pronoun (al-ʿāʾid) is omitted.
﴿إني أخاف الله والله شديد العقاب﴾: إن is an abrogating particle, the ي is its noun, and the clause أخاف الله is its khabar; الله is the mubtadaʾ (subject) and شديد العقاب is the khabar; and the clause is conjoined to what falls within the scope of the saying.

muyesser-irab:49-49.t:
﴿إذ يقول المنافقون والذين في قلوبهم مرض﴾: ﴿إذ﴾ is an adverb attached to (mutaʿalliq) the verb ﴿زين﴾ in the previous ayah, or a noun indeclinable (mabnī) on the sukūn in the position of an accusative as the mafʿūl bihi (direct object) of an omitted verb, its implied form being اذكر or اذكروا (remember); the clause ﴿يقول﴾ is in the position of a genitive as muḍāf ilayhi; المنافقون is the fāʿil (agent); الذين is conjoined to المنافقون; في قلوبهم is a fronted khabar (predicate) and مرض is the postponed mubtadaʾ (subject); and the clause is the ṣila (relative clause) of الذين, with no grammatical position.
﴿غر هؤلاء دينهم﴾: the clause is the object of saying (maqūl al-qawl); هؤلاء is the object of غر, and دينهم is its fāʿil.
﴿ومن يتوكل على الله فإن الله عزيز حكيم﴾: the و is resumptive; من is conditional, the mubtadaʾ; يتوكل is the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ); على الله is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to يتوكل; the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) is omitted, its implied form being يغلب (he will prevail); the ف links [the clause] of causation; ﴿إن الله عزيز حكيم﴾: إن is an abrogating particle (inna and its sisters), the Name of Majesty is its noun, and عزيز حكيم are its two khabars; and the clause ﴿ومن يتوكل على الله...﴾ is resumptive, with no grammatical position.

muyesser-irab:50-50.t:
﴿ولو ترى إذ يتوفى الذين كفروا الملائكة﴾: the و is resumptive; ترى is an imperfect verb, and it is visual (baṣariyya); the fāʿil (agent) is latent (mustatir), its implied form being "you" (أنت), and the mafʿūl bihi (direct object) is omitted, i.e.: the disbelievers, or their state; ﴿إذ﴾ is an adverb attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿ترى﴾, i.e.: if you could see the disbelievers, or the state of the disbelievers, when the angels take them in death at Badr; the clause ﴿يتوفى﴾ is in the position of a genitive as muḍāf ilayhi; الذين is the mafʿūl bihi and الملائكة is the fāʿil; the clause كفروا is the ṣila (relative clause) of الذين, with no grammatical position; the implied form of the apodosis is: لرأيت شيئًا عظيمًا (you would have seen something tremendous); and the clause ﴿ولو ترى إذ...﴾ is resumptive, with no grammatical position.
﴿يضربون وجوههم وأدبارهم وذوقوا عذاب الحريق﴾: the clause يضربون is a ḥāl (circumstantial) of الملائكة, or of الذين كفروا, because it contains the pronouns of both; or the fāʿil of يتوفى is the pronoun of Allah the Exalted, because He was mentioned before in His saying ﴿ومن يتوكل على الله﴾, and in that case الملائكة is a mubtadaʾ (subject) whose khabar (predicate) is what follows it, and the clause is a ḥāl of الذين كفروا. ذوقوا is conjoined to يضربون on the supposition of a saying, i.e.: and they say: taste; and عذاب الحريق is the mafʿūl bihi.

muyesser-irab:51-51.t: ﴿ذلك بما قدمت أيديكم وأن الله ليس بظلام للعبيد﴾: ذلك is nominative as mubtadaʾ (subject), and بما قدمت is its khabar (predicate); ما is maṣdariyya, or a relative; أيديكم is the fāʿil (agent); وأن الله is conjoined to ما, i.e.: that punishment is for two reasons: because of your disbelief and your sins, and because Allah…; the clause ليس is the khabar of إن [Translator's note: so in the source; i.e. of أنّ]; بظلام: the ب is a connective (ṣila) particle, and ظلام is the khabar of ليس in position; للعبيد is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ظلام; and ظلام is an intensive form (ṣīghat mubālagha) conveying attribution (nisba).

muyesser-irab:52-52.t:
﴿كدأب آل فرعون والذين من قبلهم﴾: ﴿كدأب﴾: the ك is a noun in the sense of مثل (like), indeclinable (mabnī) on the fatḥa, in the position of a nominative as the khabar (predicate) of an omitted mubtadaʾ (subject), the implied form being: دأب هؤلاء مثلُ دأب آل فرعون (the way of these is like the way of the people of Pharaoh); ﴿دأب﴾ is muḍāf ilayhi and is itself muḍāf; ﴿آل﴾ is muḍāf ilayhi and is itself muḍāf; ﴿فرعون﴾ is muḍāf ilayhi, genitive (majrūr), the sign of its genitive being the fatḥa because it is a diptote, for being a proper name and foreign; ﴿والذين﴾ is conjoined to آل; ﴿من قبلهم﴾: the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted ṣila (relative clause) of الذين, and the attached pronoun is muḍāf ilayhi; and the ṣila clause has no grammatical position.
﴿كفروا بآيات الله﴾: the clause كفروا بآيات الله is explicative of the way of the people of Pharaoh; بآيات الله is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to كفروا.
﴿فأخذهم الله بذنوبهم إن الله قوي شديد العقاب﴾: conjoined to كفروا; ﴿أخذهم الله﴾ is a verb, its mafʿūl bihi (direct object) and its fāʿil (agent); بذنوبهم is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to أخذهم; إن is an abrogating particle (inna and its sisters), the Name of Majesty is its noun, قوي is its first khabar and شديد العقاب its second khabar; and the clause ﴿كدأب آل فرعون...﴾ is resumptive, with no grammatical position.

muyesser-irab:53-53.t:
﴿ذلك بأن الله لم يك مغيرا نعمة أنعمها على قوم﴾: the demonstrative is the mubtadaʾ (subject) and بأن الله is its khabar (predicate); the clause لم يكن is the khabar of أن; يكُ is a defective imperfect verb (kāna and its sisters), jussive (majzūm) by لم, the sign of its jussive being the sukūn implied on the nūn, which was dropped for lightness; مغيرًا is its khabar; نعمة is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object) of مغيرًا, because it is an active participle; the clause أنعمها is a naʿt (adjective) of نعمة, and the ه is the mafʿūl bihi; and على قوم is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) أنعمها.
﴿حتى يغيروا ما بأنفسهم﴾: حتى is a particle of limit and of the genitive; يغيروا is an imperfect verb, accusative (manṣūb) by an implied أن after حتى, and أن with the verb is interpreted as a maṣdar (verbal noun) in the genitive by حتى, the preposition and its genitive noun being attached to مغيرًا; ما is the mafʿūl bihi; and بأنفسهم is the ṣila (relative clause) of ﴿ما﴾, with no grammatical position.
﴿وأن الله سميع عليم﴾: conjoined to what precedes it, which is why the hamza of أن has fatḥa, i.e.: and because Allah…; سميع is the first khabar of أن and عليم its second khabar.

muyesser-irab:54-54.t:
﴿كدأب آل فرعون والذين من قبلهم﴾: ﴿كدأب﴾: the ك is a noun in the sense of مثل (like), indeclinable (mabnī) on the fatḥa, in the position of a nominative as the khabar (predicate) of an omitted mubtadaʾ (subject), the implied form being: دأب هؤلاء مثلُ دأب آل فرعون (the way of these is like the way of the people of Pharaoh); ﴿دأب﴾ is muḍāf ilayhi and is itself muḍāf; ﴿آل﴾ is muḍāf ilayhi and is itself muḍāf; ﴿فرعون﴾ is muḍāf ilayhi, genitive (majrūr), the sign of its genitive being the fatḥa because it is a diptote, for being a proper name and foreign; الذين is conjoined to آل; ﴿من قبلهم﴾: the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted ṣila (relative clause) of الذين, and the attached pronoun is muḍāf ilayhi; and the ṣila clause has no grammatical position.
﴿كذبوا بآيات ربهم فأهلكناهم بذنوبهم﴾: كذبوا is a past verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the ḍamma; بآيات is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) كذبوا; ربهم is muḍāf ilayhi; the clause فأهلكناهم بذنوبهم is conjoined to كذبوا; and the clause ﴿كدأب آل فرعون...﴾ is resumptive, with no grammatical position.
﴿وأغرقنا آل فرعون﴾: conjoined to what precedes.
﴿وكل كانوا ظالمين﴾: كل is the mubtadaʾ (subject); beginning with it is permissible because of its annexation and the tanwīn standing in for the muḍāf ilayhi; and the clause كانوا ظالمين is the khabar (predicate) of كل.

muyesser-irab:55-55.t:
﴿إن شر الدواب عند الله الذين كفروا﴾: إن is an abrogating particle (inna and its sisters); شر is its noun; الدواب is muḍāf ilayhi; ﴿عند الله﴾ is an adverb attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial); الذين is the khabar (predicate) of إن; the clause كفروا is the ṣila (relative clause) of الذين, with no grammatical position; and the whole clause is resumptive.
﴿فهم لا يؤمنون﴾: the ف is the faṣīḥa fāʾ; هم is the mubtadaʾ (subject); and the clause لا يؤمنون is the khabar, i.e.: no belief is to be expected from them after they have persisted in disbelief and plunged into it.

muyesser-irab:56-56.t:
﴿الذين عاهدت منهم﴾: a badal (substitute) for الذين كفروا, so its position is the nominative, i.e.: those with whom you made a covenant among those who disbelieved; the clause عاهدت is the ṣila (relative clause) of الذين, with no grammatical position; and منهم is a ḥāl (circumstantial).
﴿ثم ينقضون عهدهم في كل مرة وهم لا يتقون﴾: ثم is a conjunction for sequence with delay (tarākhī); عهدهم is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object); في كل مرة is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ينقضون; the و is a conjunction; هم is the mubtadaʾ (subject); and the clause لا يتقون is the khabar (predicate).

muyesser-irab:57-57.t:
﴿فإما تثقفنهم في الحرب﴾: the ف is linking, because of the resemblance of the mubtadaʾ to the condition, since the relative carries a trace of it [Translator's note: so in the source; there is no mubtadaʾ or relative here, and this explanation of the fāʾ appears to have been carried over from another place; the ف here is usually taken as resumptive or explanatory]; إن is conditional and ما is connective (ṣila), the nūn being assimilated into the mīm; تثقفنهم is an imperfect verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the fatḥa because it is attached to the heavy nūn of emphasis, and it is in the position of a jussive as the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ); the ه is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object); and في الحرب is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) تثقفنهم.
﴿فشرد بهم من خلفهم﴾: the ف is linking; شرد is an imperative verb; ﴿بهم﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to شرد, the ب being in the sense of causation, i.e.: because of your making an example of them; من is the mafʿūl bihi of شرد; and خلفهم is an adverb attached to an omitted ṣila (relative clause) of ﴿مَن﴾, with no grammatical position.
﴿لعلهم يذكرون﴾: لعل is an abrogating particle (inna and its sisters), the ه is its noun, and the clause يذكرون is its khabar (predicate), i.e.: so that they may take warning from them.

muyesser-irab:58-58.t:
﴿وإما تخافن من قوم خيانة﴾: the و is a conjunction; إن is conditional, assimilated into ما, and ما is connective (ṣila); تخافن is the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ), but it is indeclinable (mabnī) because it is attached to the heavy nūn of emphasis, and the fāʿil (agent) is latent (mustatir), its implied form being "you" (أنت); من قوم is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) تخافن; and خيانة is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object).
﴿فانبذ إليهم على سواء﴾: the ف is linking; انبذ is an imperative verb; إليهم is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to انبذ; and على سواء is in the place of a ḥāl (circumstantial) of both the agent and the object together, i.e.: the agent of the verb, which is the pronoun of the Prophet, and its object, which is the genitive after إلى; i.e.: in the state of their being equal in knowledge of the breaking of the covenant.
﴿إن الله لا يحب الخائنين﴾: إن is an abrogating particle (inna and its sisters), the Name of Majesty is its noun, and the clause لا يحب الخائنين is its khabar (predicate).

muyesser-irab:59-59.t: ﴿ولا يحسبن الذين كفروا سبقوا إنهم لا يعجزون﴾: the و is a conjunction; لا is prohibitive; يحسبن is an imperfect verb, indeclinable (mabnī), in the position of a jussive by the prohibitive لا; الذين كفروا is the fāʿil (agent); the first object is omitted, i.e.: themselves (أنفسهم); the clause سبقوا is the second object of يحسبن; and إن is an abrogating particle (inna and its sisters), the ه is its noun, and the clause لا يعجزون is its khabar (predicate).

muyesser-irab:60-60.t:
﴿وأعدوا لهم ما استطعتم من قوة ومن رباط الخيل﴾: the و is a conjunction; أعدوا is an imperative verb, and the و is the fāʿil (agent); لهم is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) أعدوا; ما is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the clause استطعتم is the ṣila (relative clause) of ﴿ما﴾, with no grammatical position; من قوة is in the place of an accusative as a ḥāl (circumstantial) of the relative, or of the pronoun returning to it; and ومن رباط الخيل is conjoined to it.
﴿ترهبون به عدو الله وعدوكم وآخرين من دونهم﴾: the clause ترهبون is a ḥāl of the agent of أعدوا, i.e.: in the state of your striking terror; or a ḥāl of the object of أعدوا, which is the relative, i.e.: in the state of its being something by which terror is struck; به is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ترهبون; عدو الله is the object of ترهبون; عدوكم is conjoined to عدو الله; and آخرين is conjoined to عدوكم.
﴿لا تعلمونهم الله يعلمهم﴾: the clause لا تعلمونهم is a naʿt (adjective) of آخرين; الله is the mubtadaʾ (subject); the clause يعلمهم is the khabar (predicate); and the second object is omitted, its implied form being: محاربين (as combatants).
﴿وما تنفقوا من شيء في سبيل الله يوف إليكم وأنتم لا تظلمون﴾: the و is resumptive; ما is a jussive conditional noun in the position of an accusative as the fronted object of تنفقوا; تنفقوا is the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ); من شيء is a ḥāl; في سبيل الله is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to تنفقوا; يوف is the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ), with a latent (mustatir) nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent); إليكم is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to يوف; and the clause ﴿وما تنفقوا من شيء...﴾ is resumptive, with no grammatical position. أنتم is the mubtadaʾ, the clause لا تظلمون is the khabar, and the clause is conjoined.

muyesser-irab:61-61.t:
﴿وإن جنحوا للسلم فاجنح لها وتوكل على الله﴾: the و is a conjunction; إن is conditional; جنحوا is a past verb, and it is the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ); للسلم is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) جنحوا; the ف is linking; اجنح is an imperative verb; لها is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to اجنح; توكل is conjoined to اجنح; and على الله is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to توكل.
﴿إنه هو السميع العليم﴾: إن is an abrogating particle (inna and its sisters) and the ه is its noun; هو is a pronoun of separation (ḍamīr faṣl); السميع is the first khabar (predicate) and العليم the second khabar; or ﴿هو﴾ is the mubtadaʾ (subject), السميع العليم are its two khabars, and the clause is the khabar of إنه.

muyesser-irab:62-62.t:
﴿وإن يريدوا أن يخدعوك فإن حسبك الله﴾: the و is a conjunction; إن is conditional; يريدوا is the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ), and the و is the fāʿil (agent); أن and what falls in its scope are a maṣdar, the mafʿūl bihi (direct object). ﴿فإن حسبك الله﴾: the ف is linking; إن is an abrogating particle (inna and its sisters); حسبك is its noun and the Name of Majesty is its khabar (predicate); and the nominal clause is in the position of a jussive as the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ).
﴿هو الذي أيدك بنصره وبالمؤمنين﴾: هو is the mubtadaʾ (subject) and الذي is its khabar; the clause أيدك is the ṣila (relative clause) of الذي, with no grammatical position; بنصره is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) أيدك; and بالمؤمنين is conjoined to بنصره.

muyesser-irab:63-63.t:
﴿وألف بين قلوبهم﴾: the و is a conjunction; ألف is conjoined to أيدك; بين is an adverb attached to (mutaʿalliq) ألف; and قلوبهم is muḍāf ilayhi.
﴿لو أنفقت ما في الأرض جميعا ما ألفت بين قلوبهم﴾: لو is conditional; أنفقت is a verb and its fāʿil (agent); ما is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object); في الأرض is a naʿt (adjective); جميعًا is a ḥāl (circumstantial); ما is negative; ألفت is a verb and its fāʿil; and the clause has no grammatical position, because it is the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) of a non-jussive condition.
﴿ولكن الله ألف بينهم﴾: the و is a conjunction, or resumptive; لكن is an abrogating particle (inna and its sisters), the Name of Majesty is its noun, and the clause ألف بينهم is the khabar (predicate) of لكن; and the clause is conjoined, or resumptive with no grammatical position.
﴿إنه عزيز حكيم﴾: إن is an abrogating particle, the ه is its noun, and عزيز حكيم are its two khabars; and the clause is causal (taʿlīliyya).

muyesser-irab:64-64.t: ﴿يا أيها النبي حسبك الله ومن اتبعك من المؤمنين﴾: يا is a particle of the vocative; أي: the one addressed (munādā), an intended indefinite (nakira maqṣūda), indeclinable (mabnī) on the ḍamma, in the position of an accusative; the hāʾ (ها): for drawing attention (tanbīh); النبي is a naʿt (adjective) of ﴿أي﴾; حسبك is a fronted khabar (predicate) and the Name of Majesty is the postponed mubtadaʾ (subject), or the reverse; ﴿مَن﴾ is conjoined to the Name of Majesty; the clause اتبعك is the ṣila (relative clause) of ﴿مَن﴾, with no grammatical position; and من المؤمنين is a ḥāl (circumstantial).

muyesser-irab:65-65.t:
﴿يا أيها النبي حرض المؤمنين على القتال﴾: يا is a particle of the vocative; أي: the one addressed (munādā), an intended indefinite (nakira maqṣūda), indeclinable (mabnī) on the ḍamma, in the position of an accusative; the hāʾ (ها): for drawing attention (tanbīh); النبي is a naʿt (adjective) of ﴿أي﴾; حرض is an imperative verb and its fāʿil (agent) is "you" (أنت); المؤمنين is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object); and على القتال is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) حرض.
﴿إن يكن منكم عشرون صابرون يغلبوا مائتين﴾: إن is conditional; يكن is the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ); منكم is the fronted khabar (predicate) of يكن and عشرون is its postponed noun; صابرون is a naʿt (adjective); يغلبوا is the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ); مائتين is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object). Or يكن is complete (tāmma), عشرون is the fāʿil (agent), and منكم is a ḥāl (circumstantial).
﴿وإن يكن منكم مائة يغلبوا ألفا من الذين كفروا﴾: conjoined to what precedes; and من الذين كفروا is a naʿt of ﴿ألفا﴾.
﴿بأنهم قوم لا يفقهون﴾: بأنهم is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) يغلبوا, the ب being causal (sababiyya); أن is an abrogating particle (inna and its sisters), the ه is its noun, and قوم is its khabar; and the clause لا يفقهون is a naʿt of ﴿قوم﴾.

muyesser-irab:66-66.t:
﴿الآن خفف الله عنكم﴾: الآن is an adverb attached to (mutaʿalliq) خفف; الله is the fāʿil (agent); and عنكم is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to خفف.
﴿وعلم أن فيكم ضعفا﴾: conjoined to خفف; أن and what falls in its scope stand in place of the two objects of علم; فيكم is the fronted khabar (predicate) of أن and ضعفًا is its postponed noun.
﴿فإن يكن منكم مائة صابرة يغلبوا مائتين﴾: the ف is resumptive, and the clause after it is resumptive, with no grammatical position; إن is conditional; يكن is the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ); منكم is the fronted khabar of يكن and مائة is its postponed noun; صابرة is a naʿt (adjective); يغلبوا is the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ); مائتين is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object). Or يكن is complete (tāmma), مائة is the fāʿil, and منكم is a ḥāl (circumstantial).
﴿وإن يكن منكم ألف يغلبوا ألفين﴾: the و is a conjunction; إن is conditional; يكن is the protasis; منكم is the fronted khabar of يكن and ألف is its postponed noun; يغلبوا is the apodosis; ألفين is the mafʿūl bihi. Or يكن is complete, ألف is the fāʿil, and منكم is a ḥāl.
﴿بإذن الله والله مع الصابرين﴾: بإذن الله is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to يغلبوا; الله is the mubtadaʾ (subject); مع is an adverb of place attached to an omitted khabar; and الصابرين is muḍāf ilayhi.

muyesser-irab:67-67.t:
﴿ما كان لنبي أن يكون له أسرى﴾: ما is negative; كان is a defective past verb (kāna and its sisters); ﴿لنبي﴾ is a preposition [and its genitive noun], the fronted khabar (predicate); and أن with what falls in its scope is its noun. Or it is complete (tāmma), in the sense of "it did not happen" and "it was not right", the preposition and its genitive noun being attached to (mutaʿalliq) it, and أن with what falls in its scope being its fāʿil (agent). يكون is a defective, abrogating imperfect verb; ﴿له﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to its omitted fronted khabar; and ﴿أسرى﴾ is its postponed noun.
﴿حتى يثخن في الأرض﴾: حتى is a particle of limit and of the genitive; يثخن is an imperfect verb, accusative (manṣūb) by an implied أن after حتى, and أن with the verb is interpreted as a maṣdar (verbal noun) in the genitive by حتى; and في الأرض is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to يثخن.
﴿تريدون عرض الدنيا﴾: the clause is resumptive, with no grammatical position; and عرض الدنيا is the object of تريدون.
﴿والله يريد الآخرة﴾: the و is resumptive, or a conjunction; الله is the mubtadaʾ (subject); the clause يريد الآخرة is the khabar; and the clause ﴿والله يريد الآخرة﴾ is resumptive with no grammatical position, or conjoined.
﴿والله عزيز حكيم﴾: الله is the mubtadaʾ, عزيز is the first khabar, and حكيم a second khabar.

muyesser-irab:68-68.t: ﴿لولا كتاب من الله سبق لمسكم فيما أخذتم عذاب عظيم﴾: لولا is a particle of non-occurrence because of existence (imtināʿ li-wujūd), containing the meaning of condition; كتاب is the mubtadaʾ (subject) and the khabar (predicate) is omitted; من الله is a naʿt (adjective) of كتاب; سبق is a past verb, and it too is a naʿt of كتاب; and the khabar is omitted, its implied form being: موجود (existing). لمسكم: the ل is the lām occurring in the answer of لولا, and مسكم is a verb and its mafʿūl bihi (direct object); فيما is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) مسكم, i.e.: because of what you took; ما: a maṣdar particle, i.e.: on account of your taking, or a relative noun, i.e.: on account of that which you took; أخذتم is the ṣila (relative clause) of ﴿ما﴾, with no grammatical position; عذاب is the fāʿil (agent); and عظيم is a naʿt.

muyesser-irab:69-69.t:
